versions.changelog:
- Initial release of weekly-self-improve-loop skill.
- Adds workflow for weekly review of memory to extract metrics and friction patterns.
- Automates calculation of completion and blocker rates for the past 7 days.
- Identifies top 3 friction patterns and triggers skill creation or update for each.
- Generates a weekly report summarizing metrics, patterns, new skills, and next focus.
- Ensures privacy by reporting only aggregate, local data.
